name: What types of wall damage can be repaired with patching?

mainEntity.name: What types of wall damage can be repaired with patching?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wall patching can effectively address a variety of common wall damages. This includes small nail or screw holes, dents from impact, hairline cracks, larger holes from anchors or accidental punctures, and even stress cracks that don't indicate structural issues. We assess the damage to determine the most appropriate patching material and technique, ensuring a seamless repair. For extensive damage or signs of underlying structural problems, more comprehensive repair methods may be required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wall patching fixes nail holes, dents, hairline cracks, and larger punctures. Extensive damage may require different repair methods.
